spec.name: Halloween Ghost Memory Stand
spec.description: A low, stepped semicircular altar in dark carved wood, with purple, orange, teal and green candle pedestals. Open foreground and transparent negative space leave room for game-added ghosts. Axis-aligned geometry fits x/z 0–32 and y 0–12; no lettering or animation.

prompt: Low semicircular dark wood carnival altar with four purple orange teal and green candle pedestals. No ghosts; game adds floating ghosts. x,z0..32 y0..12. Original Orange SMP Halloween asset. Vanilla Minecraft pixel scale, material-specific irregular detail, developed UV-mapped surfaces and purposeful connected cuboids. No text, no unrelated scene, no stands, no animations, no bones except the required armor rig. Preserve transparent negative space. Model geometry must be axis-aligned, with no rotated elements. Use local vanilla references for glass, pumpkin rind, wood, iron and inventory sprites. Generated artwork will be used directly in a Paper resource pack.
